arcana.name: Arcanum of the Forge
arcana.merge: You gain Resistance to fire damage. Any fire damage you deal ignores Resistances.
arcana.dismiss:
When you dismiss this Arcanum, choose Forge or Inferno:
Forge. You create a basic weapon, armor or shield of your choice (see pages 130 to 133). If you select this option again, the previously created item vanishes. If you create a weapon this way, it deals fire damage instead of physical.
Inferno. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 fire damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Frost
arcana.merge: You gain Resistance to ice damage and are immune to enraged. Any ice damage you deal ignores Resistances.
arcana.dismiss: Ice Age. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 ice damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Gate
arcana.merge: You gain Resistance to dark damage. You gain a +1 bonus to your Magic Defense.
arcana.dismiss:
When you dismiss this Arcanum, choose Oblivion or Warp:
Oblivion. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 dark damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.
Warp. You teleport yourself and up to five other nearby willing creatures to a location you previously visited, if that location is within 1 travel day.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Grimoire
arcana.merge: You are able to read, write, speak and understand all languages. You treat your Insight as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).
arcana.dismiss: Oracle. You ask the Game Master a single question. The Game Master must answer truthfully, describing the vision shown to you by the Grimoire. Once used, this dismiss effect will not be available until the next dawn. Furthermore, the same question may never be asked more than once. The Game Master has final say on which questions are too similar to be asked again.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Oak
arcana.merge: You gain Resistance to earth and poison damage and are immune to poisoned. Whenever you recover Hit Points, you recover 5 additional Hit Points.
arcana.dismiss: Blossom. Choose any number of creatures you can see (you may also choose yourself): each of them recovers from poisoned and also recovers 40 Hit Points. This amount increases to 50 Hit Points if you are level 20 or higher, or to 60 Hit Points if you are level 40 or higher.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Sky
arcana.merge: You gain Resistance to air and bolt damage. You may use an action to accurately predict weather conditions for the next day within a range of two travel days — the Game Master will tell you what the weather conditions will be.
arcana.dismiss: Thunderstorm. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 bolt damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Sword
arcana.merge: Your attacks deal 5 extra damage, and all damage dealt by your attacks loses its type and cannot gain a type for as long as you are merged with this Arcanum (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities). When you perform an attack, you may have that attack gain the multi (any number of targets) property. If you do, this Arcanum will be automatically dismissed after the attack is resolved (this is not considered a willing dismiss).

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Tower
arcana.merge: When you summon this Arcanum, choose a damage type: air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, or ice. Until this Arcanum is dismissed, each of your allies present on the scene gains Resistance to the chosen damage type (you do not gain this Resistance).
arcana.dismiss: Judgment. Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal 30 light damage to each of them. This damage ignores Resistances.

arcana.name: Arcanum of the Wheel
arcana.merge: You are immune to slow. You gain a +1 bonus to your Defense.
arcana.dismiss: Time Freeze. Choose any number of creatures you can see: each of them suffers slow. If a creature chosen this way is already slow, that creature will instead perform one fewer action during their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
